rule.description: A method or function in the production `chalice` package whose body simultaneously carries extreme absorbed mass (>= 33 executable statements, docstrings excluded) and an absorbed sub-body signature (>= 15 statements at control-nesting depth >= 2, or nesting depth >= 5, or >= 12 if/elif branches, or >= 3 loop statements). In this codebase no hand-written routine exceeds 30 statements, so such a body can only be produced by copying the implementations of former helper methods into the caller; the branching and carrier structure left behind by those absorbed sub-bodies is what clause 2 requires, which distinguishes deeply inlined method bodies from flat bulk. The rule is applied uniformly to every function and method in the package, is name-agnostic, and accepts any behavior-preserving refactoring that extracts the absorbed fragments back into well-scoped methods and drops every body below the thresholds.

checks.description: Detect methods whose bodies contain the full implementation mass of three or more formerly separate helper methods: the extreme-statement total of an absorbed chain combined with the loop/branch/nesting signature that the absorbed sub-bodies leave behind.
checks.detected_relation: method body -> absorbed implementations of its former sub-methods (routes resolution, event synthesis, config/tag assembly, stage/state machines)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The assigned smell is defined by sub-method implementations being copied into a method instead of being called at the right abstraction level. A body that reaches 33+ executable statements in a codebase whose hand-written maximum is 30, and that also carries the nested loop/branch structure of the absorbed helpers, is exactly the relation 'the callee implementations now live inside the caller'.

matches.evidence: authorize absorbed the route-entry resolution, the Cognito JWT decoding (payload-segment split, manual base64 padding, claims extraction), the auth-event/token translation with its NotAuthorizedError handling, the method-ARN construction, and the policy-document verification with inline wildcard-to-regex rewriting; every fragment that used to be one helper call depth below authorize is now literal code inside it.

handle_request absorbed the Lambda context construction, the Lambda event synthesis (route matching, header/query/binary translation including base64 body encoding), the ForbiddenError translation for unmatched routes, and the OPTIONS preflight generation with per-view CORS header assembly; the request pipeline that used to run through dedicated factory helpers is now one literal sequential body.

update_function absorbed the function-code update stage with its retry/error-context handling, the waiter poll, the configuration payload assembly (environment, runtime, timeout, memory, role, tracing, VPC config, layers) with the create- attempts retry wrapper, and the tag reconciliation (untag/remotely-differing tags); the three-step deploy pipeline that previously dispatched to dedicated helpers is now one body.

_generate_websocketapi absorbed the per-handler integration and invoke-permission construction, the route-key creation and integration targeting, the optional custom domain-name plus api-mapping resource generation, and the websocket output section; the websocket template is now assembled literally inside the generator instead of through the per-stage helpers.

execute absorbed the plan indexing of recorded resources, the per-resource-type staleness comparison previously reached through dynamic _determine_* dispatch (including the per-api-mapping domain-name reconciliation expressed as set comparisons), and the whole deletion-planning loop with handler-args preparation and insert-vs-append plan placement; the sweep pipeline that previously ran through dedicated helpers is now one body.
